description: Fetch one audit rule by id (e.g. "core/meta-title"), including what it checks, how to fix it (recommendation), its severity and score weight, a docs link, and whether it is a cloud (credit-billed) rule (`requires_cloud`) and whether it needs the render step (`requires_render`). Rule ids appear in report topIssues and issue rule_id fields. Severity has three scales: a rule's severity (error, warning or info: get_rule, `ruleSeverity` on report rows, and `rule_severity` on issues; the severity in the llm and markdown report formats is this one too), a single check result's severity (error when the check failed, warning when it warned: `severity` on get_report summary rows, so a rule declared warning can still show an error row), and an issue's severity (list_issues and get_issue `severity`): for an issue the audit created it is high, medium or low, mapped from the rule's severity as error to high, warning to medium, info to low; for an issue a triage run planned it is the plan's priority (critical, high, medium or low), so critical can appear and a warning rule can be high. Read rule_severity for the rule's own (the highest across the issue's rules, null when the rule is no longer in the catalogue).
name: get_rule
title: Get rule detail
